links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate before vs after AI in high-risk diagnostic colonoscopy
links.effect: ADR 38.1% pre-AI vs 42.0% early (P=0.77), 40.0% established (P=0.44), 39.5% late (P=0.77); no significant differences in PDR, advanced ADR, or non-neoplastic PDR.
links.quote: In patients with an increased pre-test probability of having an abnormal colonoscopy, the current generation of AI did not yield enhanced CRC screening metrics over high-quality colonoscopy.

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical implementation and longitudinal impact of an AI computer-aided detection tool (GI Genius) on adenoma detection rates during colonoscopy, comparing pre- and post-AI introduction.
